headline: Kai, payrolls land at 8:30 with a September hike still on the table — bitcoin didn't wait, clearing $81,000 overnight.
subline: Jobs day with hike bets fading, oil near $91 after a week of Hormuz strikes, and Thursday's 1% rally recouped most of the week's losses.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:45 AM ET · equity levels are Thursday's close · every figure links to a source below

items.title: August payrolls land at 8:30 this morning
items.sentence: Economists look for about 58,000 new jobs and 4.1% unemployment, with BofA still calling for a September hike, per Kiplinger.

items.title: S&P 500 rose 1.06% to 7,747 Thursday
items.sentence: Stocks recouped most of the week's losses as bond yields eased, with the Dow adding 1.18%, per TradingEconomics.

items.title: WTI holds above $91, up nearly 10% this week
items.sentence: Crude sits at $91.25 with Brent at $95.50 as the U.S.–Iran war keeps Strait of Hormuz shipping at risk, per TradingEconomics.

items.title: Bitcoin clears $81,000 as hike bets fade
items.sentence: CoinDesk puts it at $81,024, up 4.12% in 24 hours on a weaker dollar and fading rate-hike expectations, and notes one bitcoin now buys more than 18 ounces of gold for the first time since January.

items.title: Dell jumps 15.8% on a blowout quarter
items.sentence: Adjusted EPS of $7.04 beat the $4.97 consensus on $46.97 billion in revenue, and GitLab rose 10% on its own beat, per Zacks via Yahoo Finance.

items.title: U.S. strikes Iranian tankers in Hormuz retaliation
items.sentence: The roughly 100 targets included two Iranian government tankers and missile sites, retaliation for attacks on commercial shipping, per Axios.

items.title: Diesel prices hit a record high
items.sentence: The conflicts in Iran and Ukraine are squeezing fuel supply chains and pushing diesel to unprecedented levels, per NPR.

items.title: White House targets private-college tax exemptions
items.sentence: The administration proposed stripping tax-exempt status from private colleges that keep race-based student support programs, per NPR.

items.title: Mail-voting restrictions reach the Supreme Court
items.sentence: The administration asked the justices to lift a lower-court block on USPS mail-voting limits ahead of the midterms, per NPR.

items.title: Milei escalates the Falklands oil dispute
items.sentence: Argentina imposed tougher sanctions on companies working on offshore oil development around the islands, per NPR.

items.title: Nvidia confirms $12.9 billion Hugging Face deal
items.sentence: The chipmaker moves beyond hardware by buying the open-source model hub outright, per TechCrunch.

items.title: G20 adopts light-touch AI principles
items.sentence: Members unanimously endorsed the non-binding, U.S.-backed Carolina Principles for AI governance, per Bloomberg.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 3.8 Flash weeks after 3.7
items.sentence: The new model is priced at $0.75 in and $3.75 out per million tokens, three weeks after the last release, per 9to5Google.

items.title: Sanders bill would ban superintelligence development
items.sentence: The Sanders–Casar legislation would permanently prohibit ASI work and pause advanced AI research pending federal safety rules, per AI Weekly's digest.

items.title: Altman warns of 'unsustainable silliness' in compute
items.sentence: The OpenAI chief says new entrants are pledging massive compute capacity without matching revenue or demand, per The Decoder via AI Weekly.
